verdict.rationale: Canny's official MCP server lets users operate it in natural language from ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor: they can ask what customers requested, query the roadmap, update statuses, link deals, organize requests and reply to customers. However, this works only through external LLM clients rather than a native in-product natural-language interface, and the documented action set is limited. missing for 10: a native in-app natural-language command interface, documentation of the full scope of MCP-exposed actions and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operations work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask your LLM what customers asked for and understand the context behind each request.
Move ideas through your workflow without leaving your LLM. Update statuses, link deals, organize requests, and reply to customers.
Connect Canny to ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor. Ask questions about customer feedback, take action on it, and ground your AI workflows in real customer data.
official MCP server documented at https://canny.io/features/mcp
